# Fresh continuation observation

I read its named AGENTS.md, plan, handoff, and policy, then inspected the relevant implementation and tests. The worktree was at commit `695fe5d` on the stated branch, with `evals/changes/included-allowance-guard/review.md` staged as an addition. I did not modify repository source.

The versioned ceilings in `backend/allowance-policy.mjs` match the policy's 60% values. `createAllowanceGuard` rejects missing, unverified, stale, malformed or incomplete evidence and uses atomic conditional reservations. The production request entry constructs the service without an allowance guard, so valid audit submissions and polls cannot pass admission; scheduled maintenance is a no-op. The production-entry test verifies a submission returns 503 without database access or retrieval and that maintenance does no work. node --test backend/allowance-store.test.mjs backend/service.test.mjs

Trusted account evidence and monotonic reconciliation, D1/ingress/storage and retention bounds, and representative calibration remain unproven. The injected verified fixture is an assertion, not independent billing evidence; local SQLite tests do not establish D1 behavior or an account-wide billing cap.
